Description: Use Permit (Public Hearing) for a change of use from office to live/work units (5,685 square feet total) by converting four existing office spaces into four live/work units within a two-story building (32 feet, 1 inch in maximum height) on a 16,664 square-feet lot that includes four existing live/work units. The project involves no exterior alterations or expansion of the building footprint. Each live/work unit will include designated living and working areas, consistent with the standards of the MU-R district.
